Resolves #21296

The Kanban Board and the Timeline, two of the four families Engine 14 adds, now appear in the examples section. Each group's only record gets a recipe-made cover, so both groups publish (`/examples/board`, `/examples/timeline`), and the overview reads "45 live examples in 18 groups" (base: 43 in 16). The board group names `board-basic` as its tile and gets a sentence.

Merge order: met. neomjs/pages#106 merged at `47449057f5`, and both covers serve from its `main` with the sha256 values listed below.

Evidence: L3 (one capture run of every recipe, the section's unit and e2e specs, and the overview rendered at this head with both covers served from that run) → L3 required (#21296 AC-1 to AC-6).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (published routes, group counts, the headline, band counts) and `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` (the index's groups, the headline in Production and Dev mode, ten cards in the first band); the overview pair below |
| AC-2 | The covers below. Timeline: all twelve bars whole at row height under 08:00–16:00, no cut label. Board: the In progress column over its limit (6/5) beside the All cards table, whose first two rows are the column's first two cards. Each recipe's `after` holds the named elements inside the region. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` with no selection captured 21 of 21; `board-basic` 107,194 B `5b749b6e…` and `timeline-basic` 86,088 B `efdcfb45…`, as neomjs/pages#106 lists them. The run's inputs hash to this PR's files, and it reproduced `gantt-basic` and `scheduler-basic` byte for byte. |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: `seo.json` regenerated with `node buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs -f seo-json`; `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` passed (343 routes). |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: the two specs of AC-1, `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` and the SEO specs. |
| AC-6 | The frames below. The design read is requested from the design seat, and it gates the merge; the code review runs beside it (#21296 AC-6, amended 04:28Z). |

## Deltas from ticket
- Regenerating `seo.json` also carries what merged since its last run: the missing `/learn/guides/datahandling/Timeline` route, 15 `lastmod` dates, and the value-banding example's description (#21250). All of it is generator output.
- Both recipes use `theme: default`. An example opens in the first theme its `neo-config.json` lists, and a recipe's theme only sets the browser's color scheme ([#21146 intake](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21146#issuecomment-6967931120)).
- The board's recipe scrolls the table (a `scroll` step on `.neo-grid-view`) so that both views show the same two cards.

## Cold look
Two readers without session context, each a fresh model session given only the two whole-page images, unlabelled and in swapped order, were asked how much each page makes them want to open an example (1 to 10):

| Reader | As released | As changed | Preferred, and why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1: a frontend engineer evaluating UI frameworks; released shown first | 7 | 8 | changed: "The Kanban Board card decided it" |
| 2: no persona; changed shown first | 6 | 7 | changed, "narrowly": the Kanban board is "something I instantly recognise" |

Both readers read the three Start here cards, which reappear in the bands below, as the page duplicating itself. Reader 2 also saw one particle-cloud cover front two groups (Charts, Canvas & Maps and Workers & Platform both show `offscreen-canvas`). The base shows both, so they are outside this PR: the first goes to the design seat with the design-read request, and the second is #21146's (a tile per group).

- [ ] After neomjs/pages#106, this PR and a Portal deploy, `/examples` on neomjs.com lists Kanban Board and Timeline with their covers.
